kept.concise_text: PolyResponse addresses the manual ontology design and scarce annotated in-domain data challenges by using non-generative response retrieval trained on hundreds of millions of Reddit conversations with implicit semantics.

triple.subject: PolyResponse conversational search engine
triple.object: manual ontology design and scarce annotated in-domain data challenges

verification.reason: Passages jointly support that explicit semantics create manual ontology and scarce annotated in-domain data challenges, while PolyResponse uses non-generative retrieval trained on hundreds of millions of Reddit conversations with implicit semantics as an alternative approach.

kept.concise_text: Because PolyResponse relies on retrieval-based design, it avoids engineering a structured ontology and dedicated decision-making policy modules that explicit-semantics task-oriented dialogue systems require.

triple.subject: retrieval-based design
triple.object: structured ontology and dedicated decision-making policy modules

verification.reason: Passage p003 explicitly states that due to retrieval-based design there is no need to engineer a structured ontology and that the design bypasses dedicated decision-making policy modules; p000 explains explicit-semantics systems use manually engineered ontologies.

kept.concise_text: The PolyResponse ranking model scores conversational replies and images by scaled cosine similarity between context encodings and candidate text or photo encodings.

triple.subject: PolyResponse ranking model
triple.object: conversational replies and images by scaled cosine similarity

verification.reason: Passage s01:p000 states the ranking model scores conversational replies and images and computes scores as scaled cosine similarity between context encodings and text/photo candidate encodings; other passages give encoder details.

kept.concise_text: The text encoder trained on more than 727M Reddit context-reply pairs produces the 512-dimensional $h_c$ and $h_r$ representations used by the PolyResponse similarity scoring.

verification.reason: Passages jointly support that more than 727M Reddit context-reply pairs are used for training text representations and that the text encoder maps to 512-dimensional h_c and h_r used in similarity scoring.

kept.concise_text: The photo encoder learned on around 200K Yelp photos and captions enables the system to score photos by whether their captions would be good responses to the current context.

verification.reason: Passages support that a photo encoder is learned on around 200K Yelp photos and captions, aligning captions with photo representations, enabling photo scoring by whether captions would be good responses to the context.

kept.concise_text: At inference, PolyResponse uses the Yelp dataset as the candidate pool and finds relevant text and photo responses by nearest-neighbour search over pre-computed $h_r$ and $h_p$ vectors.

triple.subject: Yelp dataset
triple.object: text and photo candidates for nearest-neighbour search

verification.reason: Passage s06:p000 says Yelp dataset provides text and photo candidates at inference; s07:p001 says inference finds nearby pre-computed h_r and h_p vectors via nearest-neighbour search.

kept.concise_text: The one-shot ranking model is extended into restaurant-browsing dialogue flow by repeatedly ranking responses, aggregating their probability scores per restaurant, and narrowing the relevant restaurant set $R$.

verification.reason: Passages jointly support extending the one-shot ranking model into a restaurant-browsing dialogue flow by repeated ranking, probability aggregation per restaurant, and updating/narrowing R.

kept.concise_text: When the narrowing dialogue flow reaches only one relevant restaurant, PolyResponse displays the top $N$ responses and relevant photos, implementing the multi-modal response capability.

triple.subject: only one relevant restaurant
triple.object: display of top $N$ responses and relevant photos

verification.reason: Passage s08:p013 states that when only one restaurant is relevant, top N responses and relevant photos are displayed; s00:p004 supports that combining text with photos yields multi-modal responses.

kept.concise_text: The 8-language PolyResponse restaurant search is enabled by a translate-to-source approach that translates foreign response pools and user utterances into English for the English-trained encodings.

verification.reason: Passages jointly support that the 8-language deployment is enabled by an MT-based translate-to-source approach translating foreign response pools and user utterances into English for English-trained encodings.

kept.concise_text: The need to reset $R$ and transfer to slot-based table booking is handled by two binary intent classifiers using the already-computed 512-dimensional $h_c$ vector.

triple.subject: two binary intent classifiers
triple.object: resetting $R$ and transferring to slot-based table booking

verification.reason: Passages jointly support that two binary intent classifiers handle resetting R and transferring to slot-based table booking, using the already-computed 512-dimensional h_c vector.
